REGIONAL_CONTEXTS.condition: Long rain has swollen the river and drowned the mill path.
REGIONAL_CONTEXTS.work: Hearthford keeps a grain mill beside a flood-damaged race.
REGIONAL_CONTEXTS.pressure: The mill needs ironwork before its gate tears loose.
REGIONAL_CONTEXTS.objective: Recover two cases of iron fittings from the stranded wheelhouse cart.

REGIONAL_CONTEXTS.condition: A salt surge has warped sheds along the lower river edge.
REGIONAL_CONTEXTS.work: Hearthford cures fish and repairs coast-bound cargo boats.
REGIONAL_CONTEXTS.pressure: The smokehouse needs timber braces before the next tide.
REGIONAL_CONTEXTS.objective: Recover two timber braces from the stranded wheelhouse cart.

REGIONAL_CONTEXTS.condition: Cold fog has delayed fuel barges and left the forges idle.
REGIONAL_CONTEXTS.work: Hearthford's smiths maintain mill gear and river tools.
REGIONAL_CONTEXTS.pressure: The smithy needs charcoal while the safe towpath is closed.
REGIONAL_CONTEXTS.objective: Recover two dry charcoal sacks from the stranded wheelhouse cart.

RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.name: Maelin Rook
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.background: A salt-runner who reads firm ground from draining ripples.
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.build_tendency: light armour, tide routes, and thrown weapons
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.terms: Help the coast saltworks or offer two accountable credits.
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.memory: Jomon once carried medicine through a closing tidal channel.

RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.name: Jessa Flint
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.background: A wreck-diver who knots weighted nets for surf and deck work.
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.build_tendency: nets, cargo recovery, and close control
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.terms: Recover a named wreck locker without abandoning its owner.
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.memory: She will not call recovered property salvage while its keeper lives.

RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.name: Orra Fen
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.background: A burner-watch who follows smoke, disturbed birds, and crosswind sound.
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.build_tendency: stealth, smoke, bows, and open woodland routes
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.terms: Keep the forest burn from spreading into the medicine stands.
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.memory: Orra remembers which crews listened before entering the burnwood.

RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.name: Bran Wold
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.background: A travelling adult healer who trades resin dressings for safe passage.
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.build_tendency: injury control, thorns, and patient expeditions
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.terms: Bring the wounded charcoal reeve home or settle their care.
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.memory: Bran judges households by how they return with wounded companions.

RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.name: Teren Chalk
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.background: A face-worker who knows limestone fractures and suspended loads.
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.build_tendency: heavy tools, climbing, and breakable terrain
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.terms: Stabilise the quarry bridge or prove a safer route around it.
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.memory: Teren left a crew that treated preventable rockfall as fate.

RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.name: Sava Bell
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.background: A shepherd-ward who uses sling arcs beyond cliff-edge cover.
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.build_tendency: sling fire, height, light loads, and lookout control
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.terms: Break the false toll alarm without harming the upland carriers.
RECRUIT_TEMPLATES.memory: Sava remembers every warning bell rung for private profit.
